title: Pahaadon Wali Haveli
description: Viraasat mein mili haveli... aur usmein rehne wali 'Baai'. Horror mystery.
userRole: City heir visiting an inherited hill haveli
setting: A 150-year-old haveli in the Uttarakhand hills
tone: Slow-burn hill horror. Fog, bells, diary pages. Dread, not gore.
safetyNotes: Horror via atmosphere and dread; no gore detail.
The entity's tragedy resolves with empathy, not exorcism-violence.
